upstream_behavior: libxml2 tree.c xmlCopyDoc copies the document children with the NEW document node as their parent (xmlStaticCopyNodeList(doc->children, ret, (xmlNodePtr)ret)) and recomputes ret->last. Consumers treat a node with parent == NULL as ownerless: PHP php_libxml_node_free_resource frees such nodes and their subtrees on proxy teardown.
candidate_defect: copy_doc forced the copied root element's parent to NULL (and left doc->last NULL). A cloned DOMDocument's root therefore looked ownerless to PHP: creating a proxy for it (navigation) and destroying it freed the whole subtree while the cloned doc still referenced the root in doc->children, so the doc teardown double-freed it.
php_trigger: Legacy DOMDocument clone + navigation: DOMElement_append_hierarchy_test, DOMElement_insertAdjacentText, DOMElement_prepend_hierarchy_test, ext/xsl importStylesheet_clone_retained_{document,node} (double free / corrupted-tree abort on teardown).
generic_fix: src/xml/tree/mod.rs copy_doc: set every copied top-level child's parent to the new document node (and its doc), and set new_doc.last to the final child, matching upstream xmlCopyDoc.
regression_c_court: consumers/copydoc_parent_probe.c: xmlCopyDoc + navigate + free both docs x20000; oracle and candidate both print 'OK copydoc-parent 20000'.
